swalco pauses paint collection at hcw ev.title: SWALCO pauses paint collection at HCW events due to Gurnee warehouse capacity
swalco pauses paint collection at hcw ev.description: Lake County SWALCO announced a temporary pause on paint collection at Household Chemical Waste (HCW) events because of limited storage capacity at the Gurnee chemical warehouse; residents are directed to alternative sites such as Park Recycling Center.
